hints: Both isBalanced and diameter are height() with extra work at each node. Compute the two child heights once and use them twice.
isBalanced: return -1 from the height helper the moment any subtree is unbalanced, and propagate it. That keeps it O(n).
diameter: the longest path bends at some node. At each node, leftHeight + rightHeight is the length in edges of the best path bending there; keep the maximum in an int passed by pointer.
source: The three most common binary-tree recursion questions
title: Balanced? Diameter? Mirror it.
